known_limitations: No fixed-scaffold model completed the selected exact revision in this six-Episode round. Current ST results are particularly weak; do not present this track as reliably solved by Astra.
One cargo item is not automatically33 percent of total task difficulty. The stronger evidence is the completed retrieval-and-return cycle with retained supplies and a credible continuation state.
Astra ST completed the different shallow-only condition in19m20s. Keep that result separate; it does not increase current-condition success counts.
A single Episode per model and track does not estimate a stable success rate, establish a model ranking, or causally identify the effect of a geometry change.
The eastern stair foot can require a side-entry jump; this was legally traversed, not removed or disclosed in the task prompt.
